changes.text: First stable release
Dashboard view with daily hours bar chart and project breakdown
Pie / Bar toggle on project breakdown chart
Drill-down: click a project to see task breakdown inside it
Consistent bar ordering — same project always in same position each day
Changelog system — What's New tab now shows structured release notes
Single-window navigation — Dashboard, Reports, Manage and Settings now live inside the main window instead of opening separate windows
Nav order: Timer → Reports → Dashboard → Manage → Settings
App renamed to Tuntio
Status column in Manage not centering correctly
Pause tracking — pause button creates a logged pause entry
Automatic ⏸ Pause system tag applied to all pause entries
Include Pauses checkbox in Reports filter bar
Paused row in By Project breakdown
Timeline chart in Reports — horizontal blocks per day coloured by project
Pause timer resets to 0 and counts up so you can see break length
Full UI overhaul — muted colour palette, card layouts, visible button borders
Today timeline now shows newest entry at the top
Timer continued running visually while paused
Overflow at the bottom of the main window
Time tracking with projects, tasks and tags
Idle detection with Keep / Discard / Split options
Today's timeline with edit, split and delete actions
Reports with date filters, project breakdown and CSV export
Hydration reminders with custom sound
Sleep / wake detection — idle prompt on resume
Global hotkeys (Ctrl+Alt+S / T / O / N)
Rotating logs and crash recovery
Auto-updates via GitHub Releases
